# vgmstream (WebAssembly)

Decoder for Wwise media (`.wem`, Wwise Vorbis) used by the audio worker (`src/audio/engine/decoder.ts`).

- Source: https://vgmstream.org/web/ (`vgmstream-cli.js`, `vgmstream-cli.wasm`), the build used by the vgmstream web player
- Version: r2117, published 2026-05-20
- License: vgmstream is ISC-style licensed, see https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/master/COPYING

To update, download both files from https://vgmstream.org/web/ and replace them here.
